pages.seoTitle: Wildroot — a modern hair salon for curls & texture
pages.seoDescription: Wildroot is a warm, plant-filled salon in Asheville specialising in curly and textured hair — cuts, colour and balayage at a human pace. Book your stylist online.

children: Come as you are, leave feeling like you
A warm, plant-filled little salon for real hair and real people — cuts, colour and curls done at a human pace, never a rushed one.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Curls and texture are our thing
Coils, curls, waves and everything in between — cut dry, curl by curl, by people who actually specialise in it. No more leaving hoping it dries right.
One person, one chair, one appointment at a time. We keep the day unhurried so you get a real consult and a proper finish, not a conveyor belt.
A room that feels good to be in
Big windows, a lot of plants, good music and better coffee. It’s the kind of hour that feels less like an errand and more like a small reset.

children: A little green, a lot of light
Wildroot is a small studio we built to feel like a warm living room — reclaimed wood, natural light, and honestly more plants than we can keep count of.
It’s a deliberate kind of calm. Fewer chairs means more attention, a slower pace, and a space you actually want to sit in for an hour.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Wildroot is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A sunlit salon full of plants and warm wood

children: We started Wildroot because we wanted a salon that felt like a real place, not a production line — somewhere warm and unhurried, where curly and textured hair is the specialty rather than the afterthought.
No upselling, no rushing, no leaving with a look you can’t recreate. Just honest cuts, soft colour, a lot of plants, and an hour that’s genuinely yours.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every appointment opens with a real conversation about your hair, your routine and what you actually want to walk out with.
Salon-grade, kinder-on-your-hair colour and care — and honest advice on the short list of things worth taking home.
We show you how to get the look again yourself, so it holds up long after you’ve left the chair.
